communication_update_interval.description: How often the controller sends a packet to the device, this is used for clock synchronization. note that is must be an even multiple of main PWM frequency

pwm_timer_phase_offset.description: How many counts to delay the start of the main phase PWM timer when synchronizing with the controller

enable_controller_syncronization.description: Enable or disable the controller synchronization feature, this is used to synchronize the device clock with the controller

controller_syncronization_valid.description: Indicates if the device is synchronized with the controller

STO_only.description: Set to 1 to enable the STO only mode, this will allow main power to stay on and only use STO to disable power

enable_power.description: Set to 1 to start power up sequence, 0 to disable power

enable_required_inputs.description: which aux inputs are required to enable startup (bitwise selection)

precharge_active.description: Indicates if the precharge contactor is active (precharging)

main_power_active.description: Indicates if the main power contactor is active (main power on)

brake_status.description: Indicates if the brakes are active, bitwise (brakes released)

enable_brakes.description: bit 0: brake 1, bit 1: brake 2, bit 2: brake 3, bit 3: brake 4, bit 4: brake 5, bit 5: brake 6

brake_1_required_inputs.description: which aux inputs are required to release the brake (bitwise selection)

brake_2_required_inputs.description: which aux inputs are required to release the brake (bitwise selection)

brake_3_required_inputs.description: which aux inputs are required to release the brake (bitwise selection)

brake_5_required_inputs.description: which aux inputs are required to release the brake (bitwise selection)

brake_6_required_inputs.description: which aux inputs are required to release the brake (bitwise selection)

precharge_delay.description: How long to wait before enabling the main contactor after precharge is started

dummy_register.description: Dummy register for pointing cyclic regs to when not in use

message_control.description: Selects the message to read back

message_time_lower.description: last time that the selected message was triggered

message_time_upper.description: last time that the selected message was triggered

device_communication_watchdog_timeout.description: How long before a timeout occurs due to no valid packet transfers
